title: 10 Ω 10 W power resistor on a base

sources.citation: The aluminium-housed wirewound power resistor, a common bench and panel class: 10 Ω in the E-series of preferred values, rated 10 W when mounted on a heat sink (typical published figures for the class, paraphrased, not one vendor's). Its resistance is taken as exact and constant; P2 has no tolerance, temperature coefficient or damage model.
game-design: the resistor on a 70 × 40 mm base, 30 mm tall, with a screw terminal at each end; not modelled on a product.
